text:
maya: quick check— prototyping an accordion cluster for long rule lists. idea: group contiguous low-impact rules into a collapsible chunk to reduce rail length.

samir: sounds useful. question: how do we indicate a cluster has internal conflicts or validation issues without forcing expand?

olivia: show a small summary row for cluster with icons + a compact badge count (e.g., 2 warnings). clicking badge expands and auto-focuses first offending rule.

jess: accessibility: when cluster expands announce via aria-live: "Cluster expanded: 12 rules, 2 warnings." focus should land on the first interactive element.

anya: for keyboard reordering inside a cluster, propose a dedicated "reorder mode" per-cluster. toggling it reveals up/down buttons and disables drag handles outside the cluster to avoid accidental moves.

samir: good. also need optimistic updates when a quick-fix runs from the cluster view so users see immediate results before server roundtrip. include undo.

olivia: quick-fix idea: inline "Resolve priority" action that opens a tiny overlay to pick guard or bump priority. keep it small so it doesn't shift layout.

jess: overlay must be keyboard-accessible and announce choices. aria announcement after apply: "Priority updated; rule moved to position 3." for reduced-motion users, skip animation.

maya: visual signal idea: add a thin left coverage bar per rule that scales with simulated hit rate. when clustered, show aggregated coverage sparkline on the summary row. hover shows counts.

sim-bot: preview-sim: cluster + coverage-sparkline landed on staging. run `preview-sim --policy 210 --samples 300` to refresh. logs: /staging/sim/210

anya: UX nit: cluster header should still allow quick drag-out: small grab handle on the right that lifts rule into edit state. avoid nested drag traps.

samir: dev note: implement overlay via portal to avoid layout thrash; lazy-load heavy editor. emit audit event for quick-fixes so Dedicated customers get trace.

olivia: I'll mock cluster collapsed/expanded, error states, and the tiny resolve overlay. two microcopy options: terse action-only vs short explainer.

jess: i'll draft aria strings and the exact announcement phrases. also add a screenreader-only summary for the coverage sparkline.

maya: timeline: mock by Wed, aria + acceptance criteria in spec by Fri. thanks team. :raised_hands:
